name: com.gamecore.recovery
description: GC-027's recovery fixtures: the versioned local checkpoint store (temporary file, checksum, atomic replacement) that 06 s7 requires and GC-018 left to the caller, the host-configured bounded retry policy and failure classification of P-049, the bounded recovery attempt transcript, and the outbox consistency report a crash/restart recovery is judged by. Unity-free by design so the same sources run in plain dotnet, in Unity EditMode and in the qualification player.
